title: Interactive Character Hero
description: An original illustrated observatory automaton turns toward the pointer through eight art-directed frames.
installation: Copy component.tsx, CursorCharacter.tsx, and useReducedMotion.ts into your component directory, copy the portrait assets to assets/, and import styles.css once. React 18 or 19 is required.
reducedMotion: CursorCharacter holds the center image and disables directional frame tracking when reduced motion is preferred. Hero entrance effects are reduced by CSS.
